Card Q&A.a: Yes, it can suspend. This card's "none of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can suspend" effect only affects Digimon with no digivolution cards. If a Digimon later obtains a digivolution card, this effect will no longer affect it.
Card Q&A.q: If an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards obtains a digivolution card after this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect activates, can that Digimon suspend?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of all of your opponent's Digimon. Until their turn ends, none of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can suspend.

[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [Mammal], [Ice-Snow] or [Hybrid] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
